description: Defines the Scope class used for script execution context management in build configuration, including nested scopes, variable handling, templates, and properties.

classes.name: Scope
classes.description: Manages variable scopes for script execution, supporting nested scopes, variable access, templates, properties, and build dependencies.

classes.name: Scope::ProgrammaticProvider
classes.description: Provides a mechanism for programmatically generating scope values, registered with a Scope.

classes.name: Scope::MergeOptions
classes.description: Configures options for merging scope variables, including overwrite behavior and exclusions.

classes.name: Scope::TemplateInvocationEntry
classes.description: Stores information about a template invocation for debugging or printing.

methods.name: Scope()
methods.description: Constructs an empty top-level scope or a dependent scope with a parent.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves a variable's value, optionally with scope info and usage counting.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets a variable's value in the current scope.

methods.name: RemoveIdentifier
methods.description: Removes a variable from the current scope.

methods.name: AddTemplate
methods.description: Associates a template with the scope.

methods.name: GetTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template by name, searching recursively.

methods.name: CheckForUnusedVars
methods.description: Checks for variables set but not used.

methods.name: MakeClosure
methods.description: Creates a copy of the scope as a closure.

methods.name: SetProcessingBuildConfig
methods.description: Flags the scope as processing a build config.

methods.name: IsProcessingBuildConfig
methods.description: Checks if the scope is processing a build config.

methods.name: SetProcessingImport
methods.description: Flags the scope as processing an import.

methods.name: IsProcessingImport
methods.description: Checks if the scope is processing an import.
